name: Fragments of the Past
objectiveText: Find the Sacred Highborne Writings in the Temple of Zin-Malor in Azshara, and bring them to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands . Sacred Highborne Writings  ( 1 )

Asenath of Noble Blade

yup, found it jus about there :)

comments.body:
The temple is at the very east end of the Ruins of Eldarath and hard to miss.  If you walk in you will see Warlord Krellian standing on a round platform in the middle of a pool.

Behind that pool are two moon-shaped ledges, on the left one (looking from the entrance) is the quest item.

See also the screenshots that have been attached by other users.

BTW the mobs in the temple are not a problem if you meet a reasonable level requirement for running BRD (55+).
Yes the book is there exactly at 42.52 just behind the levle 55 lord that stand in the middle of the altar.. Enjoy

the temple is at about 40,52, straight down the road from the alliance flight point. 

the book is sitting on the short wall that encircles the pool, behind the warlord naga.
The writings can be found near the back of the temple in Azshrara. It's a small book lying on the ledge, I had a hard time finding it the first time around.

When approaching the entrance take out the mob guarding entrance then as you enter go to right against wall, kill 3/4 mobs and the book is on a low wall against waters edge, approach from wall and take book without having to fight the lord.
Took me 7 mins from entering. then i hearthstoned back to IF

Completed this at lvl 60. Received the following rewards: 
-6000 Experience 
-Repuation with Alliance increased by 25 

Also the NPC's gives a new quest chain which ends with your choice of three green items (which I didn't find useful): 
https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=5248/tormented-by-the-past 

Hope this helps!

Did this quest at 54 (decided to finally get around to doing it - us lazy druids :P) grabbed the book and decided to kill the 55 Warlord in the middle. .dropped some money and a big mouth clam. . inside was a Golden Pearl (w00t!) Not bad for the day after christmas :)

Found the book to the right of the bottom of the ramp behind Warlord Krillian. Easy to miss if you're not paying attention. Also killed rare spawn General Fangferror upstairs, got Heavy Lamellar Vambraces of the Bear as well as 3 black pearls and 1 iridescent. All in all, a good run.
what you need to finish the quest is Sacred Highborne Writings. Its a book, in the Temple of Zin-Malor. The cords are 42, 53.

The book is directly behind the warlord on the ledge.  It is very small as others have said.  I stayed in there and farmed soul-shards from the easy mermen in there.  There is a fairly fast respawn for the temple.  You can go upstairs and kill the top floor, then go to the bottom and kill all, repeat, rinse.  Good xp even at lev 56.
But the Correct coordinates for the book are 41.52...It will be lying on the floor and I had to fight absolutely noone to get this completed

BOOK LOCATED AT 41,52

GROUND LEVEL AT THE BACK. LOOK BEHIND THE PLATFORM THE LVL 55 BAD GUY SITS ON. THERE IS A SMALL WALL THERE AND THE BOOK IS ON IT. LOOK CAREFULLY AS IT IS EASY TO MISS
The two high elves are now at the foot of Quel'Lithien Lodge - north of Northpass Tower. They moved the two for the BG.
51,29 ends QUEST

Go into the temple.
Work around to your left.
Get to the bottom of the ramp.
Swing 90 degrees to your right.
Look on the little ledge around the warlord nearest you.
The tiny little book is there!

Don't do what I did and kill everything...you could do this as a lvl 50/1 as nothing you need to kill is above 4 or 5 x lvl 52's!  You don't even need the lvl 55 in the centre.  He just gives cash to me anyway

Did it as a 57 warlock without aggroing a single mob. I just walked in the front, stayed along the wall, and grabbed the book (on a ledge near the middle, in back) while the guy nearby walked away a few feet.
there is a temple in eastern plaguelands at those coords... i thought i was going nuts, make sure you are in aszhara

Okay, this quest is easy to solo if you do it right.
As said earlier simply kill the first mob by the door and stick to the right.  Although I felt that this quest was far to easy for a level 55 pally.  Getting to Aurora before this quest was much harder I thought.
I killed the level 55 simply for fun, I could've easily ran off with the book without him even noticing.
There are no elites in this temple.

If you look behind the warlord there are 2 semi circular benches built into the floor.
The book is on the left hand one.  It's a grey book on a grey bench so you miss it at first glance!

No trouble doing this as a 54 mage.  Quick clean kills. You can pull them 1 at a time or even avoid the lot altogether if you want to. (might as well get the kills for all that trouble getting there from EP and then going back again!).  Got a few nice drops to sell at AH as well...:-)
I did this solo as a 53 druid.  Easy!  Thanks for the pic, helps a lot!
